notes: Flutter is an online betting and gaming operator, so venue, attendance, admission and pass facets mostly do not apply; no figures are in the evidence.

recreation_entertainment_activity.value: Online sports betting and iGaming operator (FanDuel, Sky Bet, Paddy Power, Sisal, Sportsbet), with Italian retail betting, slots, video lottery and racecourses via Snai

venue_service_capacity.value: Mainly online platforms rather than venues with fixed capacity; retail betting shops and two Snai racecourses are secondary

visits_event_attendance.value: Customers bet and play online; no ticketed visits or event attendance as the core business

admission_yield.value: No admission tickets; revenue comes from betting and gaming, not paid admissions

pass_membership_mix.value: No passes or memberships; customers are betting and gaming account holders

seasonality_utilization.value: Activity tied to sports calendars, such as the NFL and NBA seasons, with US football season a key driver

gaming_economics_gaming_businesses.value: Revenue from sportsbook margin on wagers and iGaming (bingo, slots, casino), plus Italian video lottery and retail betting; results depend on customer volumes and sports outcomes
